summary: Mississippi Forestry Commission Aeromotor lookout tower of the 1930s in Pontotoc County; the register says it once stood in a pasture and gives no removal record.

facts.status_note: Register says the tower once stood in the pasture; no removal date or cause given

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register October 19, 2010, nominated by Danny White

evidence.supports: constructed in 1930s by Mississippi Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: constructed in the 1930s by the Mississippi Forestry Commission

evidence.supports: once stood in center of a pasture
evidence.quote: once stood in center of a pasture

evidence.supports: location half a mile north of Goodfood and Toxish roads
evidence.quote: The location is 1/2 mile north of the Goodfood Road and Toxish Road intersection.
Looking north the skyline of Pontotoc can be seen 8.08 miles away at ground level.

evidence.supports: night view of Pontotoc street lights and radio towers
evidence.quote: At night Pontotoc street lights and radio towers can be seen.

notes_for_editor: Only one source (the FFLOS page). Two WebSearch calls and one websearch.py fallback found nothing about this tower, its staffing, or its removal. The register's build decade (1930s) is recorded in the story; no build year was inferred, so the research JSON has no built event. Access not classified. Source spells the company 'Aeromotor'; the usual spelling is 'Aermotor'. The story keeps the register's spelling.
